scope: Exact unchanged pinned Debian Firefox ESR ARM64, software/headless Wayland at 100 percent scale; ordinary wrapped native textareas. Unsupported-zoom fallback/restoration is a boundary check, not native scaled support.

implementation.provider: Existing ordinary NSTextView/NSScrollView and shared NativeUI geometry/scroll API; no new control, provider, loader, transport or UI algorithm.
implementation.geometry: Real Gecko ScrollContainerFrame scroll port, computed document rectangle and layout-range boundaries consume native clip/document/bounds. DOM getters retain their existing engine rounding/zoom path.
implementation.scroll: Native offsets use original ScrollToCSSPixels/ScrollToImpl bookkeeping and trusted event lifecycle. The existing setter receives an exact acceptable native point after native rounding, avoiding a second fractional alignment phase.
implementation.paint: Existing complete native border-box snapshot. Offset transfer occurs during reflow/input, not painting. Engine child text/scrollers/resizer remain outside the owned native snapshot.
implementation.selection: Match the actual Selection through the live TextControlState selection controller; suppress only its competing hidden-editor caret scroll. Original queued event lifetime/cleanup remains. No copied caret geometry.
implementation.lifetime: Retain semantic nodes and revalidate native widget/frame identity after engine scrolling; reuse frame destruction/freezing/inactive cleanup. Reset inherited widget state in child processes.
implementation.recovery: Restore retained engine offset to recreated native object once per authenticated host generation after text synchronization; no input action replay.
implementation.feature: NEXTSPACE_FIREFOX_MULTILINE_VIEWPORT=1 plus existing INPUT/TEXT/MULTILINE flags, provider VIEWPORT/GEOMETRY capabilities and exact libxul build/instruction guards. Not an installed desktop default.

native_pixel_scope: Fourteen complete RGB browser/provider image comparisons: six states before and after host replacement, plus reinserted and restored-scale middle positions. Shared provider was independently qualified against direct AppKit controls in the preceding NativeUI receipts.
input_scope: DOM and trusted pointer input use the fixture-owned Marionette/WebDriver connection. Native arrows include held-repeat/release. Editing in both browser families uses actual compositor-seat keys. No physical Firefox wheel qualification in this checkpoint.
binary_boundary: Only the small Firefox adapter rebuilt; browser executables/libxul, installed AppKit, NativeUI loader/provider/shim and the private Wayland backend retain their preceding hashes.

retained_failures.bitmap_status: Initial post-model geometry queries replaced the borrowed text acknowledgement with a bitmap reply, then code tested it as a model acknowledgement. Validate acknowledgement before further RPCs, then validate the bitmap; this removed repeated bind/release and engine fallback.
retained_failures.hidden_caret: A requested native scrollTop 73 later became 2. Bounded stack trace identified Selection::ScrollSelectionIntoViewEvent::Run and Selection::ScrollIntoView, revealing the hidden engine caret. Matching the owned Selection suppresses only this competing scroll.
retained_failures.pointer_focus: Trusted DOM mouse events reached the textarea but native focus ownership belonged to browser chrome. Focus the real browser pane in the fixture, preserving strict adapter focus checks. Original Alt/menu-bar behavior remains open.
retained_failures.restored_zoom: After returning from unsupported 125 percent zoom, native offset 73 became engine 72.5 through Gecko half-pixel alignment tolerance. Supplying the exact native point to the existing engine setter resolves the mismatch. Final restored geometry, trusted event and complete pixels pass.

automation_cleanup: Chromium agent-browser connection closed before session teardown; task CDP forward 9952 to 9248 cancelled. All owned fixtures terminal and no live owned processes.
remaining: Bind Firefox wheel defaults to the actual native responder, with trusted DOM cancellation and real compositor-seat parity; current Firefox wheel policy remains with the engine.

Qualify native long-document caret reveal, scrolling ancestor pages, pointer text selection/dragging, horizontal/nowrap modes, IME/accessibility, transforms and native CSS zoom/HiDPI. Unsupported 125 percent zoom currently uses the engine viewport.
Complete root web scroll-view ownership, rich text/contenteditable, other browser frontend controls/dialogs/menus, original Firefox Alt/menu-bar interaction and installed Workspace/PAM deployment.

Provide audited automatic adapter selection/installation and support other browser versions/architectures, Chrome/Vivaldi/Firefox derivatives, then continue remaining non-GNUstep GTK/Qt/KDE applications.
